ORD_SKIP_UNSEARCHED_PERM.note: F: the last learn permutation (learn_count - 1) is never searched on (learn_p = rng % (learn_count - 1)); its fold tasks, partition sort + settle and resident buffers (cursors, own-order y/w, partition, slots) are skipped. Only its own tasks read its cursors; the exported leaves are the estimation permutation's. Traced runs keep the tasks. Exported model bits unchanged (output hash comparable); trace loses *.perm.<last>.fold.* records only when tracing is off. Its T22 fold-order index was never built (cached per searched id). Default ON (waste removal); _OFF restores.

IDN_ORD_CAT_PLANES.note: C: concatenated per-permutation fold cursors (views), fit-long concatenated own-order y/w per searchable permutation; per tree ONE launch_approximate over total + ONE plane scatter instead of 2F launches, and the pooled fold bins in ONE fold_bins_from_table_kernel launch (un-gated from Apple ORD_ALL) instead of 2F create+fill+copy and a drain. Same per-row statements and integers: no bits change. Honors MOJOLEARN_IDN_ALL_OFF. Default ON; _OFF restores.

ORD_HIST_FOLD_SKIP.note: A: the leading fold partitions with fewer than parts x DOCS documents are histogrammed by ord_small_fold_hist8_kernel (global Int32 atomics into the cell, then ord_small_fold_convert_kernel: Float32(Int(raw))/scale under the 1e-20 guard); the regular 8-bit grid's blocks for those z return at entry (z_skip). Int32 sums are order-free and wrap as the shared counters do: the multiplier-1 cells, no bits change. Fixed 8-bit one-byte route, single device, device-scale submit (IDENTICAL default). DOCS default 256 (one document per thread of the block); arms 64/1024 are the sweep.

IDN_ORD_INDEX_SHARED.note: E: per searched permutation one permutation-order index (n_cols x n words) instead of T22's fold-order copy (n_cols x ~2n), plus one fold position -> permutation index map shared by all permutations; the levels gather docs through the map, kernels read stride n, dither keys on perm[i] = document id (T22's key). Same words and keys: no bits change. Memory -n_cols x n words per searched permutation; +one 2n gather per level. Takes the fold arm whether T22 is on or off (it replaces both storages). The partition readbacks stay: task_partition still needs host leaf sizes until idea B.

trees:gbdt-ordered.route: fit: fit_ordered tree loop (F skip of the unsearched learn permutation; C concatenated cursors + one derivative launch) -> fit_oblivious_tree_structure_traced fold arm (C one-launch fold bins; E permutation-order index; A small-fold histograms in compute_hist2_non_binary_dev[8]) -> batched estimation tasks
